name: Paris
notes:
LitArbi 0.9.47-beta “Paris” (build 51): the Index of Authorities and moot court mode.
• Submission ▸ Insert Index of Authorities: every legal authority your submission cites — treaties, books, articles, court decisions, awards — with the short form it is cited as and the paragraphs or pages that cite it. Update Exhibits from Brief keeps it current.
• Three new document types: Treaty / Legislation, Book / Commentary and Court Decision. The inspector's short-name field is now called “Cited as”.
• Moot court mode: free season licences for moot teams (Vis, Jessup, Henry Dunant, SAM, FDI, John H. Jackson, Manfred Lachs). New Moot Matter sets up the competition's citation forms and index; the competition's rules on AI are shown before AI is used.
